suite: Starweave independent offline UI and storage audit
method: Unmodified production engine/storage/renderer/UI evaluated in Node VM with event-capable mock DOM, simulated timers/visibility/locks/storage and finite-checking canvas. Direct storage module tests isolate exact ownership failures.
limitations: Mock DOM does not prove native dialog focus trapping, keyboard file picker activation, accessibility tree, actual layout, overflow or canvas raster quality.
Storage event and lifecycle behavior are simulated at registered handler boundaries, not across real browser processes.
Source-only accessibility findings require live-browser verification after publication.
